notes.title: Cats and Seek: Tokyo is out now!
notes.content:
Hello friends, the day we've all been waiting for is finally here 

[h1][b]🎉 Cats and Seek: Tokyo is out now! 🎉[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925320/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo/

Thank you so much for all your support and wishlists! Thanks to you, Cats and Seek: Tokyo made it into the [b]Popular Upcoming[/b] list on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/959310ac0c5b6628a046a36a89f1039569eab926.png[/img]

Just like the previous titles in the series, Cats and Seek: Tokyo is free to play with[b] 1 level [/b]where you can search for[b] 105 hidden cats[/b]. And yes, you can unlock all achievements in this free level!

If you're craving more cat-finding fun, there's also a DLC with 4 extra levels and 420 more cats waiting for you. Hopefully, it satisfies your cat-collecting cravings! ^^


[h2]So, what’s new in Cats and Seek: Tokyo?[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve added a brand-new feature called Rubber Stamp Collection, inspired by Eki stamps often found at Japanese train stations and tourist spots — a fun way to collect memories through stamps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/433fb5fd92b095a8d07e6624b37464fb4068f00f.png[/img]
[*] And a huge thank-you to our amazing community translators! because of your help, the cat descriptions in Cats and Seek: Tokyo are now available in 18 languages! We received over 120 volunteer sign-ups (so sorry we couldn’t include everyone XD some languages were completed really fast!)
[/list]

[quote]Since this was a community effort by fellow Cats and Seek players, we hope you’ll be understanding if you come across small translation hiccups. But if you notice a major issue, feel free to DM me![/quote]


-------------------

[h3]Cats and Seek: Tokyo marks the end of our Japan trilogy.[/h3]

We’re incredibly grateful we were able to complete it. This whole series is a love letter to our first-ever trip to Japan in 2019. It’s been 6 years, but it still feels like yesterday: enjoying takoyaki in Osaka, exploring Kyoto’s temples, and gazing at the bright LED lights of Tokyo. Fun fact: the cities we visited are in the exact same order as the game releases: Osaka, Kyoto, then Tokyo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2672090/Cats_and_Seek_Osaka/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2845320/Cats_and_Seek_Kyoto/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925320/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo/

We hope these games sparks some nostalgia if you’ve been to Japan before, and if you haven’t, we truly hope you’ll get the chance to go someday. 

And to everyone in Japan, thank you so much for your warmth and kindness during our time there. We really hope we can visit you again soon! ❤️

-------------------

[h3]So, what’s next for the Cats and Seek series?[/h3]

We’re not stopping! Estu already has a new idea for the next game, and we’ll be sharing more soon. If you have a theme you’d love to see in a future Cats and Seek game, feel free to drop your idea in the comments :D you might just inspire us!

If you run into any bugs or issues, please report them in the forum here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2925320/discussions/0/597399045152003671/
We’ll do our best to fix them as soon as possible!

That’s all from us for now. Thank you again for all the support, we hope you have a relaxing and cozy time with Cats and Seek: Tokyo. Happy cat-hunting! 

With love ❤️,


UB & Estu

notes.title: April Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/522d22418cdc63db9f7a88c3c5451db7f985b60b.png[/img]

Hi everyone! April’s here already, so it’s time for a little update from us about what’s been happening over last month!

[h1]All levels of Cats and Seek: Tokyo are ready![/h1]
Kamakura is the final level you’ll be able to explore through the DLC. So in total, there will be 5 levels (1 free, 4 in the DLC):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/ff6bcca196939b7d2aa8ddfd6a27a1ce89068695.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Asakusa (Free)
[*] Akihabara
[*] Ueno Park
[*] Shibuya
[*] Kamakura
[/list]
You can check out a sneak peek of the levels on [url=https://www.patreon.com/NoobzillaTeam]our Patreon post[/url]! 😺

[h1]Stamp Collection![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/433fb5fd92b095a8d07e6624b37464fb4068f00f.png[/img]
This is a brand-new feature we added, inspired by the Eki Stamps we discovered while wandering around Tokyo last year. In Japan, a lot of train stations and tourist spots have special stamps you can use as souvenirs. We loved the idea so much that we added our own hidden stamps in Cats and Seek: Tokyo! You can find them, collect them, and use them to create your very own in-game artwork. 🎨

[h1]Community Translation[/h1]
Yes! By the end of last month, we ran our very first community translation for Cats and Seek: Tokyo, and the response was amazing. We're super grateful for your support!
Thanks to everyone’s help, the game is now translated into 15 languages so far! 🎉

[list]
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Croatian
[*] Dutch
[*] Finnish

notes.title: March Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/db8e1a8ec43387abdced83c259780005b63ba803.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Time flies and here we are in March 2025! Here's a little update on what's been happening since January.

[h3]Cats and Seek: Tokyo[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/bef8f1669fd0def19386004598462647a7f53aaf.png[/img]
As of today, 4 levels are ready to play! You can explore Asakusa, Akihabara, Ueno Park, and Shibuya. Estu is currently working on the final level, making a total of 5 levels in Cats and Seek: Tokyo. One level will be available for free with all its achievements, while the other 4 will be part of the DLC for those who want extra content. The DLC is available to wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3545910/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo__Extra_Content/

[h3]Cats and Seek: Toge Land[/h3]
Back in January, we collaborated with Toge Productions to release Cats and Seek: Toge Land to celebrate their anniversary. We're so happy to see that the game has received 189 reviews so far! Thank you so much to everyone who played and left a review 🥰

[h3]Prototype[/h3]
We also tested an early prototype for another game series we're working on. So far, we've received more than 60 feedback submissions through the survey included in the prototype. Thank you so much to everyone who took the time to play and share your thoughts! If you're curious and want to try it out, you can check it out on our Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/posts/new-prototype-120037282


[h3]Patreon[/h3]
Thank you to the 180+ members who have joined our Patreon! We've been sharing sneak peeks of upcoming levels there, and we're so grateful for your support.

We also received a suggestion from one of our players about community localization. Currently, all cat descriptions are only available in English because there are so many of them, and professional translation would be too expensive for us. Meanwhile, AI translations often produce weird or awkward phrases.

I'm now looking into ways to set up a community localization system that would be easy for everyone to use. Once I figure it out, I'll share the details on Patreon. And if you're interested in helping, please join us! [url=https://www.patreon.com/NoobzillaTeam]Our Patreon is free to join[/url].


[h3]Events[/h3]
This March, we're joining two online events: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621-South-East-Asia-Game-Aesthetic/sale/ramadanfestival2025]The Days of Ramadan[/url] and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/womensdaysale]Women's Day Sale[/url]. Make sure to visit the events and check out many other awesome games! Oh, and Giant Cat is on discount too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925310/Cats_Around_Us_Giant_Cat/

[h3]Wishlist[/h3]
We're still counting on your support to wishlist our upcoming games! Your wishlist really helps us a lot. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426090/Cats_Around_Us_Black_Cat/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925320/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3545910/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo__Extra_Content/

That's all for now, thank you so much for being part of this journey with us! 😻

With love,
UB & Estu

notes.title: Special Collaboration! Cats & Seek and Toge Productions!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375896/caa247d021c426b5ae06f46b4747049dde70d2c0.png[/img]

To celebrate [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/togeproductions]Toge Production’s[/url] 16th Anniversary, we’re super excited to announce a special collaboration: 

[h1][b]Cats and Seek: Toge Land! [/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3145350/Cats_and_Seek_Toge_Land


In this edition, you’ll get to explore Toge Land, find hidden cats, and enjoy the company of some familiar characters from Toge Productions’s games. It’s a special little crossover just for [i][b]you[/b][/i]!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375896/76a218115da6d6386723d6f57f05a690f7cffa19.png[/img]

We can’t thank [url=https://x.com/sarahhana]Sarah Johana[/url] and the entire Toge team enough for giving us the chance to create this special edition. It’s been such a fun and unique project, and we really hope this serves as an awesome birthday gift for Toge Production and the fans.

When Sajo first reached out to collaborate, I couldn’t help but think this might be a sneaky way to jump the queue for the cat name submissions in Cats and Seek series hahaha. But seriously, Sajo has been supporting Cats and Seek from day one, and we’re beyond grateful for that.

This collaboration was such a refreshing change of pace for us. Between working on the Cats and Seek series, drawing Toge’s iconic characters was a blast. And it wasn’t just Sajo... Toge Productions’ whole team has been incredibly supportive. The music team even contributed their tracks to the game! How cool is that!

[h3]Happy 16th Anniversary, Toge Productions! Wishing you all the best as you continue creating amazing games for everyone to enjoy.[/h3]

Thank you again to everyone who’s been a part of this collaboration!


Cheers!


UB & Estu

----

PS : We hope you all enjoy playing Cats and Seek: Toge Land as much as we enjoyed making it. And if you finish it and still need more cats... no worries, there are hundreds more hidden in other Cats and Seek games waiting for you to find!
